Block 110 (landed; its T2 partly from this machine's #8649, #8732 and #8912, disclosed) defines the charges through derivatives of a content energy H(u, lambda): e = dH/du, tau = -dH/dlambda. Records are a Markov process with no H. (a) A new clause is needed. Two admissible energies, rest only and the activity at the crossing factor (sum over occupied-empty bonds of (1/2) sqrt(w_x w_y)/(chi_x chi_y)), both have block 110 T2(e)'s homogeneity. On the same records they give P - Q = -117/3280 and +3893397/2555120 (exact). Also exact: records transiting at the member's crossing factor (heat bath, symmetric proposals) have stationary law W(C) for every fixed clock and length field. This is block 95 T1 at a = 1/2 with the symmetric chi factor, and it holds at first order for configuration-following fields with even kernels. So they cannot form a clump in their own field; a clump needs block 97's leaving-site timing. (b) Under the activity clause at weak field, P/Q = 1 + mu<B>/(mN + mu<B>/2), with B the occupied-empty bonds: above 1 whenever a record can move. Exact on 3^3 (uniform 251/101 and 121/49; clocked gas at q = e^(6g/486) = 3/2: 2.43 and 2.34); float on 8^3 (2.48 to 2.16 for a bound clump). No record-layer virial. (c) P = Q at weak field needs a hop energy that vanishes with the field; rest only is the smallest and keeps P < Q at finite field. First-order record virial open.
